scoring_justification: Paper-reported values for alpha and H_vac are fixed quantities; agent computes them via a full DFT pipeline and checker compares against paper gold with tolerances. Recomputing from raw DOS curves or DFT outputs in the verifier is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for optimized alpha and H_vac per metal, extracted from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper DOI 10.1103/PhysRevB.90.144105, Table I (H_vac) and Table II (alpha). Cu: alpha=0.10, H_vac=1.09 eV; Ag: alpha=0.25, H_vac=0.94 eV; Au: alpha=0.40, H_vac=0.72 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of the paper’s reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published results; the checker compares the agent’s reproduced values against them with tolerances.

outputs.description: Optimized HSE mixing parameters α and computed T=0 K vacancy formation enthalpies for Cu, Ag, and Au. Checked against paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The reported values must be obtained by following the full computational pipeline; fabricating numbers does not guarantee a match to the hidden gold.

steps.description: Compare reported optimized_alpha and H_vac_eV for each metal to the paper gold within tolerances (±0.05 for alpha, ±max(0.1 eV, 10% of gold) for H_vac). Score is proportion of metals where both quantities are within tolerance.
